name: The Rationale Behind the Grenade
description: A model based on a musket equipped with the "observation grenade" module. Intended solely for display.\n"Combat is a battle of endurance, and a marksman's ammunition is always limited. Every shot must therefore be deliberate, precise, and tactically sound..."\nTo maximize combat efficiency and keep the marksman securely concealed, the "observation grenade" was conceived. Its invention turned what had once been little more than a tactical ideal into a practical reality.
